hold_text: Touches the LIVE order path: the coordinator netting guard (src/core/coordinator.py intent-mode add refusal), src/runtime/positions.py has_open_trade_for_strategy, and the M22 pairs concurrency helpers (src/units/strategies/pairs_executor.py); the manager merges under the operator's NO-HALT directive 2026-10-09 ("There is no halting.")

(a) has_open_trade_for_strategy returned False when the journal FILE was missing, so the netting guard read 'no open trade' and let a duplicate add through; it now returns None, and the coordinator refuses THAT add for THAT dispatch with net_position_unreadable (rejection row + WARN log), the next dispatch re-reads and proceeds once readable (no latch), and 3 consecutive could-not-look refusals per (account, symbol, strategy) raise ONE CRITICAL red flag via outcomes.report plus one recovery notice. (b) _pair_is_open (concurrency helpers only) folded 'unreadable' into False; it now counts an unreadable pair as possibly-open for that tick (its legs are held; it counts for the correlation haircut). Also: a flagged pairs open-state streak that ends because the pair went FLAT now reports 'cleared_flat' instead of a misleading 'recovered'; and a test pins that an open pair exits while the risk budget is unavailable. Reduce/close/flip are never blocked. No sizing, threshold or strategy-param change. Revert: git revert the merge commit.
